title: 6月货运量增4%：7月增6%，8月会否延续？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The numbers look good. Talk to me about operating ratios. Talk to me about the cost-cutting, talk to me about the efficiencies, Mario. That's what the market's been focused on.
segments.zh: 数据看起来不错。谈谈运营比率、成本削减和效率提升吧，马里奥。市场一直关注这些。

segments.en: So far, you've been able to deliver on that the past few quarters. Does that continue?
segments.zh: 到目前为止，过去几个季度你都做到了。这种情况会持续吗？

segments.en: Well, absolutely remain. We had a fantastic second quarter where we were able to improve our operating margins by 300 basis points. And for the first time in our history,
segments.zh: 当然会。第二季度表现很棒，运营利润率提高了300个基点。而且这是公司历史上首次，

segments.en: we got to an operating margin over 20 percent here in the second quarter. And that's driven by a combination of an accelerating demand environment and accelerating volumes in our network,
segments.zh: 第二季度运营利润率超过20%。这得益于需求环境加速、网络货运量增加，

segments.en: but also accelerating pricing and accelerating efficiency. So these three components, it was as enabled us to deliver on these kind of numbers and growth.
segments.zh: 还有定价和效率的提升。这三个因素让我们实现了这样的业绩和增长。

segments.en: Give me a sense here on sort of what we're seeing with regards to economic conditions.
segments.zh: 谈谈你对当前经济状况的看法。

segments.en: We had a GDP report this morning backwards looking, of course, but it gave us a sense that maybe the economy a little bit softer than what some folks had thought. But I'm taking a look at your tonnage
segments.zh: 今早的GDP报告是滞后的，但让人感觉经济可能比一些人预期的要疲软。但看看你的货运量，

segments.en: it looks like you came out of June up about 4 percent and that July, correct and far wrong, is tracking it more than 6 percent. What does that tell us about what we should expect for August
segments.zh: 6月份增长约4%，7月份（如果没算错）增长超过6%。这对8月及以后的预期意味着什么？

segments.en: and beyond? Your spot on the numbers, we have seen an acceleration of the man in our network or for our services here through the second quarter and into the beginning of the third quarter.
segments.zh: 你说得对。我们看到第二季度到第三季度初，对我们服务的需求在加速。

segments.en: But a portion of that remain was driven by our own company specific initiatives here in the second quarter and over the last few years. We've improved our service product for the customer
segments.zh: 但部分增长源于我们公司自身的举措。过去几年，我们改善了客户服务产品，

segments.en: tremendously. So we're being able to gain market share, especially with small to medium size customers.
segments.zh: 因此，我们能够获得市场份额，尤其是在中小型客户方面。
